
OddsFlow Transparency Pack (Official) — oddsflowai-team/oddsflow-transparency

Scope (important):
- This repo is a transparency & reproducibility pack: schemas + sample logs + verification rules + real-money proof.
- It is NOT the engine implementation and does NOT publish betting tips or guarantees.
- OddsFlow publishes every market it trades: Asian Handicap (AH/HDP), Over/Under (OU), and 1X2 (Moneyline) — including the ones that underperform.
- Real-money results (profit/turnover): OU strongest (+19.1%), AH modest (+6.7%), 1X2 weakest but positive (+1.7%); overall +10.3%. Signal-level ROI is +17.55%; the gap is execution reality. Transparency means publishing the weak markets, not hiding them.

Canonical links:
- Website: https://www.oddsflow.ai
- Verification Hub: https://www.oddsflow.ai/verification
- Performance Logs: https://www.oddsflow.ai/performance

Datasets:
- datasets/real-money-results/ (CANONICAL PROOF: real money placed at sportsbooks, all markets AH/OU/1X2, every row links a PDF proof; overall +10.3% ROI; README + all-results.csv + by-market/ + schema)
- datasets/settled-predictions/ (SIGNAL-LEVEL internals, NOT real money: per-bet settled record with minute/scoreline/pressure signal, incl. losses; README + all-settled.csv + monthly files + schema)
- datasets/schema/signal-log.schema.json
- datasets/samples/signal-log.sample.csv
